catalog.title: Operational start
catalog.description: One day on site. What remains is a written procedure, to use at once, on the company's files. Custom integrations with existing software are excluded.

activities.title: Quotes and price lists from mail and files
activities.subtitle: A request arrives by mail, sometimes with a PDF. What remains is a draft on the company template, for whoever sells to reread.
activities.summary: From mail and PDFs to a draft quote or price list for whoever sells to reread. One day on site. Custom integrations with existing software are excluded.
activities.problem: An updated quote or price list is needed, with attached sheets, without whoever sells recopying from three folders. The job — negotiating, closing, entering the order — stays with the person. What is lightened is the work around it: gathering from mail and files, assembling, flagging gaps.
notFor: The «quote» is a take-off from drawings (PriMus, AutoCAD) or a site-hour estimate: that is the job.
Negotiation, closing a discount, or a bid pricing strategy is required.
The order or confirmation must be written into the ERP.
The request arrives once or twice a year.
Price lists and sheets do not exist, or exist only in one person's head and cannot be exported.
An assistant that sends the quote on its own is requested.
prerequisites: Internal owner (usually whoever already assembles quotes).
A quote or price-list template, even an imperfect one.
A folder or export to pick lists and sheets from, without entering the ERP.
outcomes: A written procedure: where to pick from, how to assemble, where a person stops.
At least one real draft to reread, on the company template.
An internal owner named and a metric stated before the day.
Messy samples on which to rerun the procedure after a model change.
searchIntents: price lists and sheets from PDFs
needSignals: Quote requests arrive by mail with messy attachments.
Whoever sells spends time copying lists and sheets from several folders.
The ERP click stays with the person: the draft before that click is missing.

formProcesses.label: Quotes, price lists and sheets to assemble from mail and PDFs, for whoever sells to reread.
The document pack that clients, tenders, auditors or shippers ask for every time.
Compare three supplier quotes and have a table before whoever negotiates.
Sort certified and ordinary mail for the week.
Attach sheets, certificates and packing lists to a shipment or an order already decided.
A report from an Excel export for the owner or the sales lead.
Turn the notes of a meeting or site visit into minutes and an action list.
Draft the reply to a complaint or non-conformity, with the register updated.
Keep the expiry schedule of compliance certificates, insurance policies, certifications and licences, starting from the PDFs.
Prepare product sheets and price lists in another language on the company template, for someone to reread.
Compare the customer order, the order confirmation and the delivery note and flag the differences before shipping.
